**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Define jointly raised rejected findings**

When the external reviewer and either Ronda configuration report the same finding and adjudication rejects it or marks it out of scope, both origin rules apply: `ronda_better` is prescribed for the external-reviewer origin while `ronda_rejected` is prescribed for the Ronda origin, and `duplicate` cannot resolve the overlap because this spec defines it as a valid defect. Fresh evidence after the prior rejection-code fix is this newly introduced origin split; specify precedence or a distinct outcome so implementations record the same terminal value for jointly raised noise.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L45-L45](https://github.com/lhpaul/ronda/blob/ca420884cbd89e6852142e7cc790eb36fe2efc51/AGENTS.md#L45-L45)
